17-2226-6751.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
17-2226-6751.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Starfield Vocalist.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Lava Zombie by paying its mana cost.
When Lava Zombie enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

586-678-3899.description:
Cast Priest of Gix by paying its mana cost.
When Priest of Gix enters, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

822-4644-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Roar of the Kha is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Tidewater Minion doesn't have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
822-4644-5261.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Roar of the Kha without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Roar of the Kha, untapping all creatures you control
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.

545-4490--210.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
545-4490--210.description:
Give Shalai and Hallar lifelink, if needed.
Gain life.
Bloodbond Vampire triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Shalai and Hallar triggers, dealing damage to an opponent and causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 3.
545-4490--210.notes: Additional mana and/or prerequisites may be required depending on the method used to give Shalai and Hallar lifelink.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-1417-3249-4289--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-1417-3249-4289--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Bridge from Below triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

1479-2841-3534-8106.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Myriad Landscape.
There are two basic land cards in your library that share a basic land type.
1479-2841-3534-8106.notablePrerequisites: You control seven or more lands with different names.
1479-2841-3534-8106.description:
Fetch a land using Myriad Landscape.
When the fetched land enters, Field of the Dead and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Field of the Dead trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Field of the Dead from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Field of the Dead triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

5310-7084-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Bloodghast
When Bloodghast dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning Bloodghast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

4551-6732-8089.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is a multiple of 3.
4551-6732-8089.description:
Activate Souldrinker by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

360-1981-2415-6798.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
360-1981-2415-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

567-1981-2415-2921.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
567-1981-2415-2921.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

301-5805-7861.easyPrerequisites: At least one opponent has lost life this turn.
301-5805-7861.description:
Activate Clickslither by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Gev.
Resolve the Clickslither ability.
Repeat.

104-1379-3197-6830.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-1379-3197-6830.description:
Gain life in any way.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth.
Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

443-2438-2946-4871.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
443-2438-2946-4871.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Magus of the Bridge trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-6252-7282.description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating three token copies of Boommobile.
When the Boommobile tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, adding {12} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
1270-6252-7282.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate a Boommobile to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

2440-5295-6737-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
When Trusty Boomerang enters, Barret's triggers, creating a 2/2 Rebel creature token.
When the Rebel enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Rebel you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Rebel token.
Activate the Rebel by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
2440-5295-6737-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if you control another Rebel.

1089-1339-7307.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1089-1339-7307.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Raphael, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Curiosity triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

489-3705-4050-5997.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {R}{R}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating a 2/2 Alien Warrior creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warrior, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5330-6972-7158.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Arcbound Slasher.
When Arcbound Slasher dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Slasher's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Slasher from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.

339-413-677-1753.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
When Jegantha enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

1409-3470-5478-6839.description:
Activate Ignis by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Ignis enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Ignis.
Resolve the Ignis trigger, causing you to look at the top six cards of your library and put a land card from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking
If you put a land onto the battlefield this way, Lotus Cobra triggers, adding {U}.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat.
1409-3470-5478-6839.notes: This combo can fail if Ignis does not reveal a land. You can use additional mana to restart the combo if desired should this happen. The combo also assumes every land you grab will be mana-producing.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with toughness 5 or greater

116-3784-6657.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Gogo.
Holding priority, activate Vhal by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}{C} that cannot be spent to cast spells from your hand.
Activate Gogo by paying {4} and tapping it, copying the Kiora's Follower ability, targeting Gogo and Vhal.
Resolve both copies of the Kiora's Follower abilities, untapping Gogo and Vhal.
Repeat from step 2.

2498-3591-5636-6282.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2498-3591-5636-6282.description:
Activate Psychic Frog by discarding a card.
Necropotence triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Sheoldred triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Psychic Frog ability.
Repeat.

3586-4222-4758.description:
Activate Magus Lucea Kane by tapping it, adding {2} and causing you to copy the next ability you activate or spell you cast that has {X} in its cost.
Activate Crossroads Candleguide by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Magus Lucea Kane.
Repeat.
Once you have a large number of delayed triggers, cast a spell or activate an ability with {X} in its cost to have Magus Lucea Kane copy that spell or ability infinitely.

648-6530.description:
Cast Body of Research by paying {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U}, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to your deck size.
Activate Felothar by paying {3}, tapping it and sacrificing the Fractal, causing you to draw cards equal to the Fractal's toughness and discard cards equal to its power - causing you to draw your library and then discard that many cards.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1251-3259-6438.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1251-3259-6438.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Elsha, triggering Breath of Fury and Elsha.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

801-2393-5553-5626.notablePrerequisites: One of Greedy Freebooter or Impulsive Pilferer must be on the battlefield with the other in your graveyard.
801-2393-5553-5626.description:
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying an amount of {E}, sacrificing Greedy Freebooter or Impulsive Pilferer and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Greedy Freebooter or Impulsive Pilferer dies, it and Sifter of Skulls trigger.
Resolve the Greedy Freebooter or Impulsive Pilferer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning either Greedy Freebooter or Impulsive Pilferer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2452-3249-4506-5670--56.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast a Zombie from your graveyard this turn.
Cast the Zombie from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Rooftop Storm.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Zombie, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

331-791-3693-4522.notablePrerequisites:
Quest for Pure Flame has at least four quest counters on it.
You have a way to give Walking Ballista lifelink.
Walking Ballista has at least two +1/+1 counters on it, or your life total is at least 4.
331-791-3693-4522.description:
Activate Quest for Pure Flame by removing four quest counters from it and sacrificing it, doubling all damage dealt by sources you control this turn.
Give Walking Ballista lifelink, if needed.
If Walking Ballista has less than two +1/+1 counters on it, activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying 3 life, putting a +1/+1 counter on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 4 damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 3.

647-1069-1374-5499--24.notablePrerequisites:
You control three or more artifacts.
If the Knight has two colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of either color available.
If the Knight has three colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of any of those colors, and two mana of any other one of those colors available.
647-1069-1374-5499--24.description:
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to the Knight.
Activate the Knight by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color.
Cast the Knight from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the Knight has mana value 2 or less, this combo nets infinite mana.

2068-3562-4283.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
You have at least one creature card in your graveyard.
Whisper does not have summoning sickness.
2068-3562-4283.description:
Activate Whisper by tapping it, sacrificing Sky Hussar and any other creature you control, targeting any other creature card in your graveyard.
Ashnod the Uncaring triggers, copying Whisper's ability, targeting Sky Hussar.
Resolve the copy of Whisper's ability, returning Sky Hussar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sky Hussar enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Resolve the original Whisper ability, returning the targeted creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1965-4934-5220.description:
Cast Omarthis by paying {0}.
Omarthis enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary and Amareth trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Omarthis on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Amareth trigger, causing you to reveal Omarthis from the top of your library and put it into your hand.
Repeat.

3399-3593-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
3399-3593-5231.description:
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Stormfront Riders from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Stormfront Riders enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, returning it and any other creature you control except Thermopod from the battlefield to your hand.
Stormfront Riders' second ability triggers twice, creating two 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing a Soldier, adding {R}.
Repeat.

732-1636-4410-4939.notablePrerequisites:
Hermetic Study attached to Felhide Spiritbinder.
Felhide Spiritbinder does not have summoning sickness.
732-1636-4410-4939.description:
Activate Felhide Spiritbinder by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Burning-Tree Emissary by paying {R/G}{R/G}.
When Burning-Tree Emissary enters the battlefield, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Burning-Tree Emissary trigger, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Felhide Spiritbinder triggers, holding priority, activate it by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Felhide Spiritbinder trigger, causing you to pay {1}{R} to create a token copy of Burning-Tree Emissary with haste.
Repeat from step 3.

274-2882-4675-4694.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Cavalier of Dawn.
274-2882-4675-4694.description:
Cast Spidersilk Net by paying {0}.
Spidersilk Net enters the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Dawn.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, destroying itself and creating you a 3/3 Golem token.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn dies, triggering itself, returning Spidersilk Net from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
